statement: Binding schema_version 3 records whose target declares interface request_v2 or call_v2 plus handler_id and omits export_name validate, normalize, and reach Cell readiness through the existing binding contract, manifest, and access-policy owners, with interface-to-fixed-export mapping owned solely by component-export-resolution; schema_version 2 bindings and *_v1 interfaces normalize and activate byte-for-byte as before.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Schema v3 lands inside the existing binding contract, manifest, and access-policy owners; no parallel validator or new ingress path.
A corpus of existing schema_version 2 binding fixtures must normalize to identical output before and after the change.
